meta.title: Fog Dodge
meta.instructions: Drag or use the arrow keys to steer your cable car through the fog banks. Survive 45 seconds.

art.style: Moonlit mountain night: deep navy sky, soft lavender fog, a warm red cable car with glowing windows.
